name: Carmine
aliases: E120, carmine, cochineal, carmines, cochineal extract, carminic acid, carmín, ácido carmínico, cochinilla, rouge de cochenille
what_is: A red food dye extracted from the dried bodies of female cochineal insects.
why_botia: It flags it because it is derived from insects, making it of animal origin and non-halal (haram) according to several Islamic jurisprudences.
can_1: Detect the presence of E120 or its synonyms in the ingredient list.
can_2: Alert consumers of its insect origin for vegan, vegetarian, and religious dietary preferences.
cannot_1: Determine the concentration of carmine used in the food product.
cannot_2: Verify if the extraction solvents or carrier substances used during manufacturing comply with specific purity limits.

sources.label: Codex General Guidelines for Use of the Term Halal (CAC/GL 24-1997)
